title: First Lessons: Ember
introNarration: Mentor Cinder sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of Ember. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Cinder.
completionNarration: Cinder nods once. Ember has your name, if not yet your fire.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of Ember.
